annotations.title: EVE Frontier Sui Move PTB Coin-Drain & HotPotato Safety Simulator

description: Simulates Sui Programmable Transaction Block (PTB) command sequences to detect unauthorized coin splits, object transfers, and unconsumed HotPotato receipts. Use when auditing an untrusted EVE Frontier transaction bundle before signing with a pilot wallet; for verifying pilot zkLogin JWT proofs and character ownership capabilities, use verify_eve_zklogin_character instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'ptb_commands_json' ('strictness_mode' defaults to 'strict_zero_drain'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (35 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

ptb_commands_json.description: JSON-serialized array of PTB commands or comma-separated Move calls (e.g. '[{"kind":"SplitCoins"},{"kind":"MoveCall"}]').

strictness_mode.description: Simulation policy controlling whether multi-transfer PTBs are blocked; defaults to 'strict_zero_drain' when omitted.

name: simulate_eve_sui_ptb

hidden_coin_transfer_detected.description: True if unauthorized SplitCoins or TransferObjects drains are detected.

hot_potato_receipts_balanced.description: True if every Move HotPotato struct created in the PTB is consumed before exit.

ptb_command_count.description: Number of PTB commands statically simulated.
